Karbala say sham tak Sajjad Khon Rota raha
Dekhy lashy bekafan ZAINAB ko dekha be rida

1
Zakham hi zakham thy pao me chalay kasay bimar
Kar diya bora u say Jis nay wo hai sham bazar

2
Raho me Ro Ro k wo ZAINAB ki chadar mangta
Lash Akbar ki jawan dekhi waha Khon me ter

3
Nok e niza pay chara dekha hai asghar ka bi sir
Dekha sir Abbas ka ghoray ki garden me para

4
Aisay abid pay karo zulm ye uth na pay
Naam lety raho ZAINAB ka esay gush aye
Mar na Jay e raho ne ZAINAB tanha asra

5
Nok e neza pay rida es ko dikhaty jao
Sham tak Khon mohari ko rolaty jao

6
Har qadam pay ye kahy hay sham ZAINAB berida
Ghr jo ZAINAB ko bazaro me na laty mehdi

7
Khon e shabir ko Sajad na bhola tha kabhi
ZAINAB o Sajad k khotbo say zindan deen howa

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/karbala-se-sham-tk-sajjad-khon-rota-raha.md')

roman, body = s.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].split('\\n---\\n')
def blocks(lyrics):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in lyrics.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r = blocks('\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in roman.splitlines()))
u = blocks(body)
assert len(r) == len(u) == 8
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in u] == [2,3,3,3,4,3,3,3]
assert [b[0] for b in u[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')
print('17 corresponding verses across the opening and seven stanzas')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Urdu script and verified that the opening and seven stanzas match the structure of `romanLyrics`. Preserved the Roman wording with capitalization normalized, set the direction to RTL, and removed `noUrdu`.

The Roman phrases `kasay bimar`, `raho ne Zainab tanha asra`, and `khon mohari` are ambiguous. I rendered them as `کیسے بیمار`, `راہوں نے زینب تنہا اسرا`, and `خوں مہاری`.
